name: devfoxxlabs-agent-standards
description: Production-grade engineering standards, security baselines, DPDP compliance frameworks, and AI agent skills authored by DevFoxx Labs (Karunendu Mishra).

standards.name: India DPDP Compliance First
standards.description: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 & DPDP Rules 2025 compliance foundation for Web, Mobile, and Backends.

standards.name: Security by Design
standards.description: Four-layer defence model based on OWASP ASVS 5.0 L2/L3, OWASP Top 10, API Security Top 10, MASVS, and CWE Top 25.

standards.name: Database Safety & ACID
standards.description: Environment awareness, destructive command prevention, additive expand-migrate-contract schema changes, and ACID transactions.

standards.name: Icons: Hugeicons (Free) Everywhere
standards.description: Strict standard enforcing Hugeicons free stroke rounded icons across Web and Flutter apps.

standards.name: Flutter Screen Protection & Overflow Prevention
standards.description: Mandatory Safe Area insets, RenderFlex overflow resilience, dynamic data rule, skeleton loading, and image caching.

standards.name: Engineering Workflow
standards.description: Read before, record after, verify before done: change log, known gaps, owner TODO, use what's installed, S.O.L.I.D, fail-closed feature flags.

standards.name: Web Performance: Core Web Vitals
standards.description: LCP <= 2.5 s, INP <= 200 ms, CLS <= 0.1 at p75 mobile: server-rendered LCP, JS budgets, sized media, deferred third parties, Lighthouse CI gate and web-vitals RUM.

thirdParty.install: npx -y skills add vercel-labs/skills -g -s find-skills -a codex -y
